Bill Hair: Well look, I think we've seen a pretty remarkable set of events at the cop in Turkey.
Bill Hair: Um, the main thing for me is that the cover decision, the main decision has been blocked by a whole bunch of countries who are very unhappy about the fact that it didn't mention the transition away from fossil fuels.
